name: bq-inheritance-gifts
description: Analyse inheritance and gift tax scope for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba in 2026. Use for the former Antillean succession tax, European Netherlands residence connections, emigrant donors or estates, entity gifts and related BES transfers or distributions. Explains saved liabilities, territorial definitions and distinct ten-year and one-year deemed-residence tests. Includes primary statutes, current authority guidance and fictional classification cases. This source-cited draft holds actual estate valuation, exemptions, foreign relief, forms and civil-law qualification. Load with the universal workflow base and applicable tax references; professional review remains required before reliance.
